items.text: Vikings ruled out WR Justin Jefferson due to ankle injury sustained in game vs Bucs.
items.why: Ankle injury in first half; officially ruled out.
items.implication: Heavy target share shifts to Addison/Hockenson; Jefferson managers scramble for Week 4+.
items.opportunity: Boosted routes/targets for Jordan Addison and T.J. Hockenson.

items.text: 49ers WR Mike Evans carted off and ruled out with rib injury/strain vs Cardinals; full eval Monday.
items.why: Rib strain after hard hit; carted, ruled out after halftime.
items.implication: Painful injury; target share to Deebo/Kittle; check severity for multi-week risk.
items.opportunity: Increased snaps/routes for Deebo Samuel and George Kittle.

items.text: Jets RB Breece Hall ruled out with thigh/quad injury vs Lions after late discomfort.
items.why: Thigh injury on tackle; ruled out remainder of game.
items.implication: Jets RB committee opens; monitor backups for next week volume spike.
items.opportunity: Expanded carries for remaining Jets RBs.

items.text: Dolphins RB De'Von Achane ruled out vs Chiefs with knee injury after awkward tackle; coach described as major concern with more testing upcoming.
items.why: Knee injury mid-game, ruled out remainder; coach pessimistic.
items.implication: Major blow to MIA backfield; monitor handcuffs and remaining RBs for expanded role ROS/waivers.
items.opportunity: Increased carries/targets for other Dolphins RBs if multi-week.

items.text: Ravens WR Zay Flowers active vs Cowboys after pregame workout on hamstring; looked good, decision reversed from team not counting on him.
items.why: Pregame workout successful; official active after GTD reports.
items.implication: Startable if rostered; reverse prior Bateman/Andrews beneficiaries.
items.opportunity: Full WR1 role if limited snap risk low.

items.text: Bears expected to start Case Keenum at QB vs Eagles MNF; Caleb Williams already ruled out (hamstring), Bagent cleared concussion but practiced limited.
items.why: Hamstring; Keenum preferred starter over limited Bagent.
items.implication: Bears offense downgrade; WR/TE volumes may suffer under Keenum.
items.opportunity: Monitor Bears pass-catchers for any residual upside.

items.text: Cash must-plays: Jahmyr Gibbs absurd role/setup vs Jets (proj 27.7/44.4 ceil); Kenneth Walker elite role vs weak Dolphins; Garrett Wilson high upside at value with missing Jets pass-catchers. Strong start to season.
items.why: Salary-adjusted value, role/talent/matchup data; Wilson 30%+ targets.
items.implication: Core cash pieces; any lineup without Gibbs flawed at price.

items.text: Post-Sunday injuries watching: Achane (knee), Jefferson (ankle), Hall (quad), Etienne (ham), Evans (rib), Mayfield (thumb)/McMillan (knee), Coker (quad), Andrews (hand), Spears (ankle), Bech (broken forearm).
items.why: Comprehensive list of impactful fantasy injuries from Sunday games.
items.implication: Week 4 prep focus; severity TBD for several stars.

items.text: Rams WR Puka Nacua inactive for SNF vs Broncos.
items.implication: Adams primary WR; volume to other Rams receivers.

items.text: Raiders TE Brock Bowers active and making 2026 season debut vs Saints after knee recovery.
items.why: Officially active for debut post-knee issue.
items.implication: Immediate TE1 upside; Mayer snaps drop.
items.opportunity: High route/target share as primary TE.

items.text: If Zay Flowers active for Ravens, start him over Bateman; risky but active means active for me.
items.why: Active confirmation overrides prior risk; prefers over Bateman.
items.implication: Start Flowers in fantasy lineups if rostered.

items.text: AD Mitchell expected inactive (finger); Jets WR depth: Garrett Wilson clear #1, then Isaiah Williams etc; TE Kenyon Sadiq hybrid slot/wide role expected. High opportunity for Wilson.
items.why: Mitchell GTD to inactive; missing multiple pass-catchers opens targets.
items.implication: Wilson 30%+ target share projected; strong cash/DFS play vs Lions secondary.
items.opportunity: Elevated routes/targets/snaps for Wilson; Sadiq hybrid usage.

items.text: Pregame: Flowers GTD (not counting on); Spears hopeful GTD. Expected: Warren/Pittman, Barkley/Smith, Bowers, Evans, Coker, Coleman. Q: Parkinson trending right, Bagent. Later updated Moore limited/Mitchell out, Flowers out-proj initially.
items.why: Compiled weekend reports for fantasy decisions.
items.implication: Guided projections and late swaps; many hit expected then some post-game changes.

items.text: Trevor Lawrence knelt to set up Bhayshul Tuten rushing TD; shoutout to Tuten fantasy owners.
items.why: Coach/QB intentional support for Tuten fantasy value via kneel.
items.implication: Positive usage signal for Jaguars RB depth/role.
